baselineRecovery.limitation: Current baseline recovered from a verified full review. Missing historical weekly inputs and unresolved overlays retain their separate limitations.

researchReview.scope: Late-day change-only Week 5 review across all 30 active teams and 15 games from the latest VERIFIED main daily sweep cutoff through completion. Official injury reports, transactions, starter status, personnel/replacement roles, offensive line, pass rush, secondary, playmakers, coaching, weather and schedule/rest/travel information were reviewed without market access.

signConvention.spreadHome: Negative = home favorite; positive = home underdog.
signConvention.gap: Pinnacle home spread minus Graham home fair. Positive = Graham stronger on home; negative = Graham stronger on away.
signConvention.moneylinePair: Displayed as away / home American prices.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Dallas reported Porter as a high-level outside starter for the injured cornerback room and documented his Week 4 debut; using him for Durant's additional vacated outside-corner duties is a labelled primary-role estimate.
personnelEstimateCases.precision: Estimated injury loss rounded once to 0.001; subsequent weekly arithmetic is exact.
personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Replacement allocation is a labelled Graham estimate using frozen values or explicitly source-bound supplements. It is not confirmed workload or an empirical confidence interval. QB, playing impairment and unreviewed clusters remain separate.
personnelEstimateCases.reopenOn: Dallas changes the Week 5 outside-corner allocation, Joey Porter Jr. becomes unavailable, or Cobie Durant returns.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Shelton's immutable frozen healthy value is 0.0; the nonnegative loss floor yields zero without assigning a replacement.

personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Frozen healthy value is calibrated zero and the replacement floor is nonnegative; no missing replacement value is assigned zero.
